headline: Chilean Regulator Approves Steel Plant Restart
summary: Chile's competition authority has cleared Aceros AZA to take control of the Huachipato steel plant, which has been idle since 2024. CAP will retain a 15% stake in the facility.
why: The restart of a major industrial facility is significant for Chile's manufacturing sector and local employment.

impacts.name: CAP
impacts.why: The restart of an idle asset is generally viewed as a positive development for the parent company.
